title: Poeme
identity: Zdenko Fibich’s Poème has multiple arrangements. The SaxoBrain lead identifies a Carl Fuerstner alto saxophone and piano arrangement, Etoile 001; a separate Schott/Boosey Birtel arrangement found in research is for other ensembles and does not verify the saxophone item. Target publisher record remains unconfirmed.

evidence.claim: Etoile/Groth product lead identifies Carl Fuerstner as arranger and the composer spelling Zdenko Fibich.

Schott/Boosey catalog excerpt lists Wolfgang Birtel arrangements of Poème for string trio, piano trio, and wind quintet. It does not list saxophone, so it is distinct from and does not verify the cataloged saxophone edition.

review_focus: Verify the cataloged Carl Fuerstner saxophone edition, then inspect its solo line and original source. The Birtel listings concern other ensembles.
collection_flag: Romantic transcription; avoid assuming simplified or student-oriented without examining the arrangement.
gaps: No primary publisher or library record independently confirms the Carl Fuerstner saxophone arrangement or Etoile 001.
No saxophone score or performance recording was inspected.
